titles: Delay penalty with no exclusion for client-caused delay
Client can terminate without paying for work

all_findings.title: Liability is unlimited
all_findings.comparison: Past contracts: 8 of 10 cap liability at about 1x fees; highest seen 2x.
all_findings.quote: Vendor's liability under this Agreement is unlimited.

all_findings.title: Delay penalty with no exclusion for client-caused delay
all_findings.why: AtliQ could pay for delays it did not cause (Brightwater).
all_findings.comparison: Past contracts cap penalties at 5% of the milestone and exclude client delay (3 of 3).
all_findings.quote: If Vendor fails to complete any milestone by its due date, Vendor shall pay Client liquidated damages of two percent (2%) of the total project fee for each week of delay until completion.

all_findings.title: Indemnity covers client negligence
all_findings.why: AtliQ would bear liability for client’s own fault.
all_findings.comparison: AtliQ expects mutual indemnity, not covering other's negligence.
all_findings.quote: Vendor shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Client ... including claims arising from Client's own negligence.

all_findings.title: Client can terminate without paying for work
all_findings.why: AtliQ may lose compensation for services already performed.
all_findings.comparison: Standard contracts require payment for work done on termination.
all_findings.quote: Client may terminate at any time for convenience without payment for work in progress.

all_findings.title: Client ownership of pre‑existing tools
all_findings.why: AtliQ loses rights to its own tools, contrary to standard practice.
all_findings.comparison: Usually client owns deliverables but AtliQ retains pre‑existing IP.
all_findings.claimed_quote: All work product, including Vendor's pre‑existing tools incorporated in it, is owned by Client on creation.

all_findings.title: Payment in 60 days
all_findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
all_findings.quote: Client shall pay each invoice within sixty (60) days of the invoice date.
